correctness.rationale: The proof reduces pointwise evaluation to the positive semidefinite Legendre Gram matrix with probability-normalized kernel. The standard-library checker reconstructs 15 H3 line coordinates and their four pair classes, verifies 16 low ranks by Gaussian elimination over Q(sqrt5), checks two exact row-sum nullities, and verifies 200 nonzero modular determinants at p=1009 (all recurrence denominators invertible). Strict Bernstein/Gershgorin diagonal dominance proves full rank for all l>=216. Thus the sharp permanent interpolation threshold l=15 follows, with no finite-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The 15 antipodal H3 lines are a natural noncrystallographic harmonic-sampling configuration, not an arbitrary slice. The full degree-wise interpolation image is genuinely nonmonotone: first surjectivity at degree 7, exact one-dimensional mean obstructions at 8 and 14, and permanent surjectivity from degree 15. The exceptional rank-10 degree 6 and constructive minimum-energy interpolation add useful exact information. A sharp all-degree cutoff and complete rank classification on this canonical orbit are meaningful even without a condition-number theorem.
